capabilities: Render full-width-space paragraph indentation in Live Preview, Source mode, and Reading view
Render ruby (furigana) and emphasis dots in Kakuyomu, Aozora Bunko, and Narou notation
Insert or remove ruby and emphasis markup and copy the current heading section via commands
Count characters in the status bar and next to headings, excluding whitespace, callouts, and markup
Highlight the active editor pane and optionally the cursor line in split views
extras: English documentation covers features and usage, but the full per-option settings reference and caveats are in Japanese only; the README carries an as-is warranty disclaimer and a changelog through 0.1.10.
problem: Obsidian misaligns Japanese full-width-space indentation, cannot render ruby or emphasis-dot notation, and counts words rather than the characters Japanese prose is measured by.
